front: How many states were in the German Confederation of 1815?
back: 39, with Austria holding the presidency of the Diet at Frankfurt.
'Little Germany': a united Germany without Austria, led by Prussia.
'Greater Germany': a united Germany including the German lands of the Austrian Empire.

front: When did the Frankfurt Parliament open?
What did Frederick William IV do in April 1849?
back: He refused the crown of a united Germany offered by the Frankfurt Parliament.
Prussia abandoned its Erfurt Union under Austrian pressure; the Confederation was restored in 1851.
Measures of the Confederation that censored the press, supervised universities and banned student societies.

front: Why did the Frankfurt Parliament fail?
back: No army or taxes, divisions over Greater or Little Germany, the recovery of the princes, and the refusal of the crown.
